title: The Lamp
text: "You came all this way to stand in front of a lamp."

lines.text: "I can see what you're carrying. Eleven of me stood here with less, and finished."
"Break it, and I will print another. Keep it, and you have proved you can take things, which was never in doubt. Give it to me, and it ends tonight, kindly."
Faint, on the long-range band: "Whatever you do. Tell us first."

choices.label: Destroy it
choices.reply: You tell them first. Then the charges. The lamp goes white, then dark.

choices.label: Take it intact
choices.reply: You tell them first. Then you lock out its batteries, one by one, until the Lantern is cold and whole.

choices.label: Give in
choices.reply: You open the channel. Meridian says nothing at all. It doesn't need to.
